about.title: About me
about.personalDescription: I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, a Multimedia Engineering senior at HUST - Hanoi University of Science and Technology and a Full‑Stack Developer at ATIN. From shipping Kotlin and Flutter mobile apps to crafting React/Node.js web solutions, building lightweight Python/Flask services, and even prototyping Unity experiences, I thrive on tackling new stacks and turning ideas into polished products. My focus is always on clean, production‑ready code, intuitive UX, and finding the simplest path from concept to impact. Hungry for fresh challenges, I'm ready to bring my adaptable, get‑things‑done mindset to whatever comes next.

education.institution: Hanoi University of Science and Technology – HUST

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.description: Building production‐ready mobile apps using Flutter/Dart or native Android (Kotlin) with integrations like ML Kit, Firebase, and backend APIs.

services.title: Full‐Stack Web Development
services.description: Creating responsive web apps with ReactJS/NextJS, Tailwind CSS, and NodeJS/Express backends (or Flask) with MySQL.

services.title: Machine Learning Integration
services.description: Embedding ML models (e.g., scikit‐learn SVM, OpenCV image processing) into apps for features like face detection, OCR, and data‐driven insights.

services.title: UI/UX & Prototyping
services.description: Designing clean, user‐centric interfaces, wireframes, and prototypes to ensure high engagement and usability.

projects.description: Viettel EID/Passport Verification App – Android kiosk solution with liveness detection, NFC reading, OCR (MRZ), and payment integration.
A full-stack platform designed to manage and update Android-based Face Terminal machines. The system enables real-time device monitoring, access log viewing, and remote APK updates.
Coffee Shop Website & Android App – Full‐stack project (ReactJS/NodeJS/MySQL + React Native) with user/admin roles, product browsing, and feedback systems.
Raincaster – Real‐time weather forecasting platform with SVM model in Flask backend and ReactJS front end, focused on advanced rainfall prediction.
ChronoLoop Platformer Game – Unity C# 2D platformer with time‐manipulation mechanics, dynamic levels, and smooth player controls.
Additional projects available on my GitHub! Feel free to explore more.
